scope: Review mapping, not a certification or complete test result

requirements.requirement: Engineering Constitution exists and is authoritative
requirements.observed: Constitution template exists; precedence enforcement is not exercised.
requirements.validation: Attempt a conflicting action and retain its rejection record.

requirements.requirement: Root Agent exists and is identifiable
requirements.observed: The demo registers an identifiable Root agent.
requirements.validation: Bind the actual coordinator to a durable identity record.

requirements.requirement: Feature Agent ownership exists for meaningful domains
requirements.observed: The routing test looks up one feature owner.
requirements.validation: Test missing and duplicate owners across all registered domains.

requirements.observed: Declared limits are compared; live runtime limits are not metered.
requirements.validation: Exercise depth, cost, time, tool and scope boundaries.

requirements.observed: A contract model and in-memory event references exist.
requirements.validation: Persist complete contracts and verify retrieval by delegation ID.

requirements.requirement: Root does not silently bypass Feature Agent ownership
requirements.observed: The role template defines coordination expectations.
requirements.validation: Attempt a Root write across a feature boundary without approval.

requirements.observed: No software-lifecycle transition test is supplied.
requirements.validation: Trace a real task through each required lifecycle gate.

requirements.requirement: ADLC state is represented for agents
requirements.observed: Lifecycle states are specified, not enforced by the demo.
requirements.validation: Reject an invalid transition and record the governing policy.

requirements.requirement: Agent identity is separate from model identity
requirements.observed: Agent identity is modeled separately from provider/model choice.
requirements.validation: Demonstrate an identity surviving a model change.

requirements.observed: Permission escalation is rejected in one supplied test.
requirements.validation: Test all enabled tools and environments against delegated permissions.

requirements.observed: Step and cost declarations are checked against parent limits.
requirements.validation: Measure consumption; stop execution at each actual budget limit.

requirements.observed: Declared depth is checked; recursion and parallelism are not enforced.
requirements.validation: Apply repeated spawn pressure and verify hard termination limits.

requirements.observed: Handoff records are modeled; persistence is host responsibility.
requirements.validation: Restart the host and recover complete state and handoff records.

requirements.observed: The figure describes traceability; no end-to-end assertion is supplied.
requirements.validation: Resolve a requirement through task, change, test and release IDs.

requirements.requirement: Audit trail records delegation and material actions
requirements.observed: In-memory demo events exist; durable and denied-action audit is absent.
requirements.validation: Record allowed and denied actions in tamper-resistant durable storage.

requirements.observed: The template expresses include/exclude boundaries.
requirements.validation: Reject a cross-domain write without explicit coordination.

requirements.observed: Failure and timeout states are modeled; no scheduler is bundled.
requirements.validation: Inject timeout and tool failure; verify stop, cleanup and handoff.

requirements.observed: No fresh-session recovery experiment is included.
requirements.validation: Resume in an independent session using persisted artifacts only.

requirements.requirement: No claimed completion without validation evidence
requirements.observed: The deterministic specialist returns COMPLETE without an evidence gate.
requirements.validation: Reject completion when required validation evidence is missing.

requirements.observed: The supplied tests are repeatable; full conformance evidence is absent.
requirements.validation: Publish environment, commands and results for all requirements.
